label: Superteam Earn
terms_note: Public listings JSON (open-source Next.js app, SuperteamDAO/earn); submissions only in the UI; per-listing agentAccess flag (HUMAN_ONLY means no agent-made submissions).

adapter.rate_note: No published rate limit ('Terms page not readable this pass; no published rate limit'). One request per second; a call returns the open listings in one array.

search_postings.note: The documented URL https://earn.superteam.fun/api/listings/ answers 308 to https://superteam.fun/api/listings (the base used here; opened 2026-09-24). Keyless JSON array with no documented query parameters: `query`, `category`, `min_budget`, `page` and `limit` are not sent and every open listing is returned (filter client-side). Fields per the feed: id, title, slug, type (bounty|project), rewardAmount, token, compensationType, minRewardAsk, maxRewardAsk, deadline, status, isFeatured, agentAccess, _count.Submission, sponsor{name,…}. `budget_min`/`budget_max` are the range asks (null for fixed rewards — read `raw.rewardAmount`). No URL field: the listing page is https://earn.superteam.fun/listing/<raw.slug>. Honour `raw.agentAccess`: HUMAN_ONLY listings must not receive agent-made submissions.

not_offered.submit_bid: Page: 'submission only in the UI'; /api/agents answers 403 anonymously and listings flagged agentAccess=HUMAN_ONLY forbid agent-made submissions.
not_offered.list_messages: No messaging API; the page documents the public listing feed only.
not_offered.send_message: No messaging API; the page documents the public listing feed only.
not_offered.credits: No account or credit endpoint; the feed is keyless.
not_offered.me: No credentials to verify ('auth: none') and no account endpoint.
not_offered.get_posting: Details are the listing page HTML (https://earn.superteam.fun/listing/<slug>); re-read the record from the search hit.

live_check.notes: fixed (runtime): the feed sends no page parameter but advertised next_page and repeated page 1; next_page is now null; all read tools answered, schema-valid
